svg.title: 02 IT CAME FROM THE GREAT SALT LAKE (xerox monster tee)

g.text: VISIT SALT LAKE / CONCEPT ROUND 1 / STREETWEAR LANE
02 IT CAME FROM THE GREAT SALT LAKE (xerox monster tee)
One-color photocopy tee. A brine shrimp, a half-inch animal that is the lake's whole economy, enlarged into a B-movie monster coming for a hardcore crowd.
ALL AGES * NO RE-ENTRY * ACTUAL SIZE 1/2 INCH

svg.text: FRONT / 14 x 15.5 IN, 1-COLOR, 2 IN BELOW COLLAR
BACK / UPPER BACK HIT 4 x 2 IN WITH LIFE-SIZE SHRIMP
Hand-cut collage logic (05-brain-dead-sunn-o-tee, 30-flickr-flyer-b, 31-flickr-flyer-c): a drawing of a brine shrimp blown up on the copier until it is a monster, taped over a xeroxed
photo of the lake and a crowd, with a horror title bar. The SVG approximates copier grain with a filter; production art is a real photocopy, scanned.

g.text: BLANK: 7 oz heavyweight tee, 100% cotton, Cream #F6F1EC (off-white, not optic). Boxy cut, 1 in ribbed collar, double-needle hems.
DECORATION: 1-color screen print, Ink #212121 water-based ink, 110 mesh, no halftone cleanup; keep every copier speck in the separation.
PLACEMENTS: front 14 x 15.5 in, 2 in below collar seam; upper back 4 x 2 in, 1.5 in below collar (life-size shrimp, 1/2 in).
COLORWAY: Cream / Ink. Alt: Salt Pink #F58B88 body / Ink print (the pink flyer), or Ink body / Cream print flipped negative.
